status: development after preserved v4/v5 failures; no independent validation claim
feature_policy: per-record positive-definite second-moment summaries and matrix logarithm; fixed identity ridge 0.001 after trace normalization; no population or label fitting during representation extraction
binder: 8 public channels, frequency-averaged 30-48Hz ITPC, all released times in [0,0.55]; rows=time and columns=channels; second moments encode joint spatial structure, not connectivity or voltage
wielek: two successive one-hot 5-state vectors; only contiguous epoch links within the same time_record; joint second moment includes transition structure, not merely state occupancy
mendeley: clean chronological raw 4-second-block relative five-band integrated powers and log band powers centered within each block; joint second moments encode inter-band structure; no covariance of artificial concatenated EEG seams
anchor: fixed original uHNDI, transformed by training-median/IQR asinh; raw T and original uHNDI both retained
geometry_kernel: Gaussian on vectorized matrix logs with off-diagonal sqrt(2) factor; width is median positive training squared distance
learning: bounded correction eta*tanh(K beta) trained with pairwise logistic loss and ridge*beta^T K beta/2 plus 1e-8*||beta||^2/2; RKHS smoothness, no residual independence claim
selection: mean inner-fold AUC; ties within 1e-12 prefer eta=0 then smaller eta and stronger ridge
primary_metric: mean within-fold AUC and equal-weight macro mean, every seed reported
performance_target: positive macro delta versus both strong baselines at every predefined seed and positive mean cohort deltas versus both; positive macro mean delta versus diagonal-only geometry to support joint information
historical_policy: preserve all historical studies and failures; isolated results/joint_geometry_v6
scope: mathematical descriptors of released measurements; no claim of EEG connectivity, circuit mechanism, unique novelty or clinical necessity
